mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising > 0.25 percentage points in one month) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in one month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 650 and RSAFS > 360000, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high unemployment periods (UNRATE > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy to stimulate job growth, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO rises, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in industrial production (INDPRO falling below 100 in one month) signals economic contraction that reduces corporate earnings expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 650 and GDPC1 > 13200, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve's tightening cycle increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
